summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature by editing rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. The diff is insertion-only (589, 210, 38, and 1 lines added; no deletions). Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black were not executed, per the instruction to work only by reading and editing files. Choices beyond the spec: the reader defines name and mode as delegating properties so it can instantiate on older Pythons; Progress.wrap_file annotates total as Optional[float]; Progress.open stats the file before creating the task but opens the handle after, so a failed open can leave a task behind, as the spec's ordering implies. Known risk: the module-level open passes a str mode into the literal-overloaded Progress.open, which mypy may flag without a suppression. No commits were made.
